03 / AI, USED WITH DISCIPLINE

Ask. Inspect.
Correct. Then build.

AI helped choose the niche and draft an audit. It also overstated what its evidence supported. This project preserves the correction instead of hiding it.

The checker uses explicit reviewed records and deterministic rules. It does not ask a language model to guess a fit at runtime.

The mistake we caught

The first AI draft called a match “confirmed” without showing the primary-source locator. It added “only” without proving exclusivity and said a retailer listing needed correction without establishing a defect.

The rule that changed

An affirmative match needs a read manufacturer source and exact locator. A listed compatible model is not proof that all other models are excluded. Another AI's answer is a draft, not evidence.

What the real data taught us

The reviewed Filter A page names 5500. The Filter H page names 5500-2. Similar names cannot be merged. Manuals corroborate 5500-2, AM80 and 5300-2. This is documentary validation, not a physical test.

Test without inventing sales

Test exact matches, suffix preservation, unknown models, wrong selected SKUs, region ambiguity, conflicting records and stale review dates. Commercial value remains unmeasured until actual seller outcomes are available.

RUN THE DECISION CHECKS

Checks use a controlled October 7, 2026 date and real model names; conflict and stale-date scenarios are controlled fixtures, not manufacturer claims.
